name: Bowprod Gauge
description: Plant the boot firmly in the stirrup and brace the crossbow upright so the prod cannot twist during spanning.

name: Latchgauge
description: Haul the string back with both hands and a straight back until it seats on the nut.

name: Judging Trigger
description: Run a thumb over the nut and latch to confirm the string sits true before a bolt is laid.

name: Tending Boltrail
description: Lay a bolt flat in the groove with the fletching under the forefinger so it cannot slip.

name: Firm Cranking
description: Seat the stock against the shoulder and squeeze the trigger straight back to loose one bolt at a near target.

name: Deep Sear
description: Rest the cheek on the stock and line the eye with the bolt rail to find the target.

name: Tending Windlass
description: Hold the breath at the bottom of an exhale so the aim stops drifting before release.

name: Kind Stock
description: Sight along the rail to the middle of the target and judge the fall of the bolt by eye.

name: Sudden Stirrup
description: Squeeze the trigger slowly with the pad of the finger so the bolt leaves without a jerk.

name: Searbump
description: Loose a steady bolt at a motionless mark so the head drives through light cover.

name: Stockreview
description: After a miss lower the bow and reset the stance and breath before aiming again.

name: Tripbar Count
description: Roll both wrists slowly through full circles to loosen the joints before heavy spanning.

name: Measured Latch
description: Hold the spanned bow level at arm length for a slow count to build forearm endurance.

name: Gentle Cranequin
description: Flex and sight along each limb of the prod to find cracks or twist before use.

name: Bowprod Review
description: Tuck the thumbs below the rail so a loosed string cannot strike them.

name: Boltrail Gauge
description: Lower the bow after each span and shake out the hands to keep the grip sure.

name: Stockhit
description: Sit on a bench and span by hand and loose a single bolt at a short target.

name: Mild Sear
description: Ease the string forward by hand on an empty bow to rest the prod without a dry loose.

name: Deep Latch
description: Roll each bolt on a flat palm to find a bent shaft before it is loaded.

name: Searreview
description: Draw each vane between two fingers to set the fletching flat and true.

name: Tending Stirrup
description: Twist the bolt head to feel for a loose socket and reject any that moves.

name: Stocknote
description: Draw one bolt from the quiver by touch alone without looking away from the target.

name: Latchcount
description: Hang spare bolts on a belt hook so the next one is always under the hand.

name: Steady Stock
description: Cup the bolt in the palm and slide it forward into the groove in one motion.

name: Seargauge
description: Pin the bolt against the rail with the thumb while the bow is lifted to the shoulder.

name: Setback Bump
description: Loose a bolt quickly at a close target straight after a clean load.

name: Searnote
description: Wrap the leading hand under the tiller ahead of the nut so the bow stays level.

name: Latchreview
description: Seat the butt of the stock in the pocket of the shoulder to absorb the shove of release.

name: Skipping Twang
description: Turn the hips square to the target and set the feet apart for a stable firing base.

name: Smooth Tripbar
description: Carry the spanned bow with the tiller level and the bolt pointed at the ground ahead.

name: Searamble
description: Pivot on the front foot a quarter turn to bring the bow onto a new target.

name: Single Releaseclack
description: Press the stock hard into the shoulder and loose a bolt that flies flat.

name: Steady Trigger
description: Rest the thumb on the safety catch while moving so a snag cannot loose the bow.

name: Judging Cranequin
description: Sling the bow unspanned across the back before scaling a bank or a fence.

name: Releaseclack Hop
description: Kneel and rest the bow across the thighs whenever a spanned bow must wait.

name: Soft Stirrup
description: Keep the trigger finger flat along the rail until the target is truly chosen.

name: Hard Twang
description: Walk at a slow pace with the bow at low ready and loose at once when called.

name: Steady Windlass
description: Circulate a thread of qi through the arms to hold the spanned bow rock still.

name: Tending Tripbar
description: Touch a breath of qi to the head of the quarrel to settle its flight.

name: Twangblow
description: Loose a quarrel carried by a thread of qi in a flat line at a standing target.

name: Deep Cranequin
description: Push qi into the legs as the string is spanned so the draw costs less strength.

name: Searcount
description: Feel the pulse in the fingertips and loose between beats so the aim does not jump.

name: Stockcount
description: Trace qi along the rail to confirm the bolt lies straight before release.

name: Judging Windlass
description: Slide a fresh quarrel home with a flick of qi so the next loose follows quickly.

name: Mild Stock
description: Sink into a crouch and let a little qi root the legs so the body stays low and firm.

name: Latchnote
description: Set the elbow on the raised knee to lock the arm and steady the bow.

name: Searhop
description: Slide forward on the belly with the bow held clear of the ground to change position.

name: Latchamble
description: Roll from a crouch to a new firing spot with the bow tucked against the chest.

name: Shifting Span
description: Step heel first with qi damping the sound so the shooter closes quietly.

name: Short Trigger
description: Loose from a deep crouch so the bolt flies low and the body presents a small mark.

name: Short Span
description: Loose from one knee with the elbow braced so the bolt flies truer than a standing shot.

name: Leaden Sear
description: Loose from lying prone with qi through the forearms so the bolt strikes cleanly from cover.

name: Calm Latch
description: Judge how far the bolt will fall by eye and note the mark on the rail.

name: Measured Stirrup
description: Measure how far ahead of a walker to aim by pacing the steps of the target.

name: Even Cranequin
description: Hold a thread of qi in the aiming eye to keep the lead point fixed on a moving mark.

name: Calm Boltrail
description: Raise the bow a fingerwidth to offset the drop of a long shot.

name: Leading Setback
description: Loose ahead of a walking target so the bolt arrives where the target will be.

name: Gnawing Cranking
description: Tilt the bow up and loose a lobbed bolt that drops onto a distant mark.

name: Soft Bowprod
description: Span the bow to a steady count and rest only on the beat with a breath of qi in the arms.

name: Twangpace
description: Shift two steps sideways with the bow loaded and level to find a clear line.

name: Stockgauge
description: Hold a second bolt between the fingers so it can seat the instant the first is gone.

name: Searblow
description: Loose the opening bolt of a drill round at the nearest mark.

name: Latchbump
description: Loose the closing bolt of a drill round at the farthest mark with settled breath.

name: Even Tripbar
description: Pat the cheek and shake out the arms after a round to recover feel.

name: Calm Trigger
description: Sweep the eyes over every mark before the round to plan the order of shots.

name: Gentle Sear
description: Let a thread of qi through the shoulder ease the weight of a spanned bow on a long march.

name: Deep Stock
description: Flip the bow from the carry strap to the shoulder in one pull.

name: Easing Quarrel
description: Press behind a tree or a rock with the bow held close to the chest.

name: Warm Latch
description: Pass the bow from hand to hand while waiting so neither arm tires.

name: Wide Twang
description: Halt mid march and loose a single bolt at a sudden target.

name: Mild Boltrail
description: Set the quiver on the strong hip so the hand falls on the bolts without searching.

name: Judging Bowprod
description: Count the bolts left in the quiver by touch while keeping the eyes on the foe.

name: Even Latch
description: Flick qi along the fingers to draw a bolt faster than the hand alone.

name: Smooth Cranequin
description: Hold a steady beat of span and load and aim and loose so each cycle takes the same time.

name: Kind Trigger
description: Let a dropped bolt go and draw another at once rather than stooping to find it.

name: Quarrel Dash
description: Loose one bolt and seat the next before the target has moved far.

name: Open Releaseclack
description: Loose three bolts in rhythm at one mark without breaking the stance.

name: Cranking Dodge
description: Step back and draw the sidearm when the last bolt is gone.
